query: 95-year-old man—among male ICU patients aged 90–100 with hepatic failure on first ICU stay, stratify distinct diagnostic procedures in initial 72 hours into quartiles and report per quartile number of patients, min/max/mean procedures, mean LOS (days), and in‑hospital mortality (%)
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, i.icustay_id, pr.procedure_code, pr.procedure_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.icustay_id) AS patient_count, MIN(i.icustay_id) AS min_icustay_id, MAX(i.icustay_id) AS max_icustay_id, AVG(i.icustay_id) AS avg_icustay_id, AVG(i.length_of_stay) AS avg_length_of_stay, SUM(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mortality_count FROM patients p JOIN icustays i ON p.subject_id = i.subject_id JOIN procedures_icd pr ON i.hadm_id = pr.subject_id AND i.stay_id = pr.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age = 95 AND p.anchor_year BETWEEN 90 AND 100 AND i.first_careunit = 'ICU' AND i.hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd WHERE icd_code = '448') AND i.stay_id IN (SELECT stay_id FROM chartevents WHERE charttime BETWEEN i.intime AND i.outtime AND itemid IN (SELECT itemid FROM d_items WHERE category = 'Procedure')) GROUP BY p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, i.icustay_id, pr.procedure_code, pr.procedure_name ORDER BY patient_count DESC, min_icustay_id ASC, max_icustay_id ASC, avg_icustay_id ASC, avg_length_of_stay ASC, mortality_count ASC;
